note: Reconstructed from the saved results in commit 9ee502e: the run's own record names its url, its text parts, its state list and every part of every root, and this config restates those. The root is the `dl`, which the reference marks with no attribute of its own, so it is named by tag. `textParts` is root, title and info, because each is as wide as its own text (the title's is `whitespace-nowrap`, and the info slot is an inline box beside it) and the text is set in our own font. `states` is `base` alone: the info icon is a tooltip trigger, and its hover behaviour is a behaviour check rather than a style one.
